requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features and manageability solutions for the Magellan printer, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan capabilities, and AI-powered device management via a consolidated SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: AI features are highlighted as a major differentiator and are critical to meeting SMB customer needs for efficiency and ease of management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features (Perfect Print, Perfect Scan, AI device management) are available and functional in the product release, validated by user acceptance testing and feedback from SMB customers.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design the Magellan printer to deliver HP's lowest business TCO for SMBs, including minimal intervention and maintenance requirements.
requirements.Rationale: SMB customers prioritize ROI and efficiency; minimizing TCO is a key selling point and competitive differentiator.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent cost analysis demonstrates Magellan's TCO is lower than comparable HP and competitor models for SMB use cases.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Parts and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Enable customer replaceable parts (e.g., maintenance box, PHA) and ensure serviceability through both customer and service center options, with clear thresholds for each.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and support costs for SMBs without dedicated IT, improving overall user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documentation and physical design allow end users to replace specified parts; service center support is available for other components. Field testing confirms successful replacement by non-IT staff.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles for Supplies
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to ensure proper installation and reduce supply errors or counterfeit risks.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents incorrect usage and supports supply chain integrity, a concern for SMBs managing multiple devices.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All ink bottles are uniquely keyed and cannot be incorrectly installed. Testing demonstrates error prevention in typical SMB environments.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal (SMB portal) for managing multiple printers, targeting the needs of unmanaged or lightly managed SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Enables non-IT staff to manage fleets of printers efficiently, addressing a primary customer pain point.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is operational, supports management of 6-15 printers per SMB, and is validated via usability testing with target users.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS and Advanced View SMB Portal (Non-PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Ensure the Magellan printer supports Printing-as-a-Service (PaaS) and Advanced View SMB portal for non-PDL SKUs.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with HP's strategic goal for PaaS acceleration and provides SMBs with flexible, scalable solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs are compatible with PaaS and Advanced View SMB portal, confirmed by integration and functional testing.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance and Features
requirements.Description: PDL SKUs must achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19), support PDL/PS, and comply with Blue Angel environmental certification.
requirements.Rationale: Meets performance expectations for higher-end SMB segments and aligns with sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKUs pass speed benchmarks, support PDL/PS, and receive Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Design the Magellan printer to utilize at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor standards (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability leadership and is a key differentiator for environmentally conscious SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and third-party verification confirm at least 60% RCP in final product.

requirements.Title: Warranty – 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Provides assurance to SMBs regarding durability and reliability, supporting purchase decisions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published and honored; field data shows compliance with warranty limits.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing capabilities and seamless integration with the HP App for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses modern SMB workflows and enhances user convenience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices via the HP App; successful end-to-end testing with iOS and Android devices.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to collect and report printer usage, health, and performance data for proactive support and analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Enables HP and customers to monitor device health and usage, supporting predictive maintenance and improved service.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is securely collected, transmitted, and accessible via SMB portal; compliance with privacy regulations is verified.
